conceptual assets.information: Unpredictable bytes generated by the entropy cells, debiased, accumulated and buffered for software reads; the TRNG depends on providing these bytes.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality: generated bytes are exposed in the software read response through fifo.rdata at line 117. Integrity: the enable and FIFO-clear path can discard pending generated values and cause a zero replacement on the read path at lines 115-117 and 170. Availability: disabling generation or clearing the FIFO can withhold the bytes, as shown at lines 137, 170 and 114-117. Undermined Expected Behavior: the SIM_MODE build choice selects simulated rather than physical inverter behavior at lines 132 and 439-451, and the RTL warns that simulation mode provides no true physical random output at lines 288-289.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could read the response to obtain generated bytes, disable or clear the generator and FIFO to discard them, or integrate the IP in simulation mode so its output is not true physical randomness.

conceptual assets.information: The software-programmable enable setting controls whether entropy sampling runs and whether the random-data FIFO is cleared; TRNG operation depends on this setting.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: a bus write changes the stored enable setting at line 105. Availability: the setting controls the generator through line 137 and causes the FIFO to clear when disabled through line 170.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could write the control register with enable cleared, disabling entropy generation and clearing pending random data.

considered, not kept.reason: TRNG_FIFO only fixes FIFO_DEPTH at build time and cannot be changed or withheld at run time, so it is excluded as a build-time value (lines 22 and 147).
SIM_MODE is a build-time generic rather than run-time information that an element can modify or withhold, despite selecting the simulated path at lines 132 and 444-451.

The request strobe, direction, address selection and response acknowledge only qualify accesses or handshake transfers, so access-command and bus-handshake rules exclude them as separate pieces (lines 98-108 and 171).

reply keys: the 2026-10-13 format as written in 'raw'; 'reply' holds it in v5 keys
